questions.stem: A translator's notes ask why the golden rule maximizes consumption; explain the condition.

answer.exemplar: The golden rule sets the marginal product of capital equal to depreciation plus population growth, maximizing steady-state consumption per worker.

questions.explanation: Consumption is maximized when the marginal product of capital equals break-even investment. Higher capital beyond that lowers consumption.
